<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Remocao manual de service_availability quando o Service Commitment existe mas nao possui nenhum relacionamento em service_offering_commitment. Preserva compromissos com qualquer vinculo, registra nome/sys_id e quantidade removida. Nao executado na criacao. DRY_RUN=true permite simulacao. Record for rollback habilitado. Nao corrige pares individuais quando o compromisso ainda tem outro vinculo.</description><name>LAB - Cleanup orphan Service Availabilit</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[/*
 * Global Fix Script - limpeza manual de disponibilidades sem offering relationship.
 * Preserva o Service Commitment e compromissos com qualquer relacionamento existente.
 * DRY_RUN=true apenas simula; false remove. Executar com Record for rollback marcado.
 */
(function () {
    var DRY_RUN = false;
    var SOURCE = 'CleanupOrphanServiceAvailability';
    var removedTotal = 0, candidateTotal = 0, skipped = 0, failures = 0;

    function log(message) { gs.info(message, SOURCE); }
    function hasRelationship(id) {
        var relationship = new GlideRecord('service_offering_commitment');
        relationship.addQuery('service_commitment', id);
        relationship.setLimit(1);
        relationship.query();
        return relationship.hasNext();
    }

    var availability = new GlideRecord('service_availability');
    var relationships = new GlideRecord('service_offering_commitment');
    if (!availability.isValid() || !availability.isValidField('service_commitment') ||
            !relationships.isValid() || !relationships.isValidField('service_commitment')) {
        gs.error('Schema invalido; nenhuma exclusao realizada.', SOURCE);
        return;
    }

    // Percorre os compromissos que possuem disponibilidades, inclusive sem vinculo atual.
    var groups = new GlideAggregate('service_availability');
    groups.addNotNullQuery('service_commitment');
    groups.addAggregate('COUNT');
    groups.groupBy('service_commitment');
    groups.query();
    log('Inicio | Modo: ' + (DRY_RUN ? 'SIMULACAO' : 'EXCLUSAO'));

    while (groups.next()) {
        var commitmentId = groups.getValue('service_commitment');
        if (hasRelationship(commitmentId)) { skipped++; continue; }

        var commitment = new GlideRecord('service_commitment');
        if (!commitment.get(commitmentId)) {
            gs.warn('Service Commitment ausente: ' + commitmentId +
                '; ignorado para revisao manual.', SOURCE);
            continue;
        }

        var removed = 0, candidates = 0, errors = 0;
        var records = new GlideRecord('service_availability');
        records.addQuery('service_commitment', commitmentId);
        records.query();
        while (records.next()) {
            // Revalida antes de cada exclusao para interromper se um vinculo surgir.
            if (hasRelationship(commitmentId)) {
                gs.warn('Relacionamento identificado durante a execucao; interrompida a limpeza de ' +
                    commitmentId, SOURCE);
                break;
            }
            candidates++;
            if (DRY_RUN) { continue; }
            var availabilityId = records.getUniqueValue();
            try {
                if (records.deleteRecord()) { removed++; }
                else {
                    errors++;
                    gs.error('Falha ao remover Service Availability: ' + availabilityId, SOURCE);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                errors++;
                gs.error('Falha ao remover Service Availability: ' + availabilityId + ' | ' + e, SOURCE);
            }
        }
        candidateTotal += candidates;
        removedTotal += removed;
        failures += errors;
        log('Service Commitment: ' + commitment.getDisplayValue() + ' - ' + commitmentId +
            '; Offering Relationship: ' + (hasRelationship(commitmentId) ? 'Identificado durante a execucao' : 'Não Identificado') +
            '; Service Availability: ' + removed + ' Removidos' +
            (DRY_RUN ? '; Simulacao: ' + candidates + ' candidatos' : '') +
            '; Falhas: ' + errors);
    }
    log('Fim | Candidatos: ' + candidateTotal + '; Removidos: ' + removedTotal +
        '; Compromissos preservados com relacionamento: ' + skipped + '; Falhas: ' + failures);
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-20 00:26:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>1b153fd5c348df18e079b13ed401310f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB - Cleanup orphan Service Availabilit</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_1b153fd5c348df18e079b13ed401310f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-20 00:26:46</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
